placements.why: Both segments establish calibration as an organizational concern — verifying instrument state against reference standards and ratifying it as a settled decision. No existing strata or narrative leaf covers this category; it names an organizational domain the repo will accumulate content under.
placements.title: From claimed to verified instrument state
placements.frame: What establishes an instrument's calibration as settled and trustworthy?

placements.title: From asserting calibration to verifying it against reference plates
placements.frame: How does verification against reference standards transform a calibration claim into a settled outcome?
placements.why: Both segments cohere around the calibration of the Kestrelwood spectrograph — src-1 performs the verification claim (88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates, holds across the full observing band) while src-2 ratifies that same outcome as a settled decision. The theme is instrument calibration verified against reference standards, a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — not a one-time fact but a recurring practice this leaf accumulates support for.
